tools.name: cast
tools.description: Start a casting: real creators film the app and post it on their own accounts. With dry_run: true nothing is saved and nobody is contacted; you get who SeedViews will look for, the brief, the opening message (opening_message_preview), the price, the totals and the timeline to show your person. Witho

tools.name: send_offers
tools.description: Approves the brief and the opening message together, so outreach starts: SeedViews begins messaging real creators and sending them the paid offer. This reaches real people; confirm the brief and opening_message_preview with your person first. Optional brief, looking_for and opening_message are final

tools.name: check_video
tools.description: Without approve, only reads a video's check and approval state (is the post live on the creator's own account, when it counts as approved). approve: true approves it, which lets the creator be paid from money already collected. approve: false needs reason and sends the video back to the creator. Ask

tools.name: pay_creator
tools.description: Approves one creator payout. The money comes from what was already collected for the casting; the creator is then paid automatically. This moves money: ask your person first unless they told you not to.

tools.name: get_results
tools.description: Reads the casting: status, the opening message, each creator and their state (found, contacted, replied, signed, filming, posted, checked, paid, passed) with our first message to them, each video with views and cost per 1,000 views, totals, and needs_person (what a human must do next, if anything).

tools.name: get_files
tools.description: Lists the original file of every approved or paid video, with its post link and the ad-rights line (12 months from the post date, final video only). Read only.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cast, send_offers, check_video, get_results, get_files · Private data: cast, get_files · Public sink: cast, send_offers, check_video, get_files.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cast, send_offers, check_video, get_results, get_files · Private data: cast, get_files · Public sink: cast, send_offers, check_video, get_files

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

title: Tool description changed since last scan
detail: Tool "cast" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
